title.en: Tetravalence of carbon and structural representations

hook.en: Millions of organic compounds are known, from sugar to plastics, and almost all of them rest on one fact: carbon forms four bonds.
hook.kn: ಸಕ್ಕರೆಯಿಂದ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಕ್‌ವರೆಗೆ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಸಾವಯವ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತಗಳಿವೆ; ಅವೆಲ್ಲದರ ಆಧಾರ ಒಂದೇ: ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Millions of organic compounds are known, from sugar to plastics, and almost all of them rest on one fact: carbon forms four bonds.
narration.kn: ಸಕ್ಕರೆಯಿಂದ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಕ್‌ವರೆಗೆ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಸಾವಯವ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತಗಳಿವೆ; ಅವೆಲ್ಲದರ ಆಧಾರ ಒಂದೇ: ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A carbon with four single bonds is sp³ and tetrahedral (109.5°); with one double bond it is sp² and trigonal planar (120°); with a triple bond or two double bonds it is sp and linear (180°). More s-character makes the carbon more electronegative and the bonds shorter: C–C 154 pm, C=C 134 pm, C≡C 120 pm.
body.kn: ನಾಲ್ಕು ಏಕಬಂಧಗಳ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ sp³ ಚತುಷ್ಫಲಕೀಯ; ಒಂದು ದ್ವಿಬಂಧ ಇದ್ದರೆ sp² ತ್ರಿಕೋನ ಸಮತಲ; ತ್ರಿಬಂಧ ಇದ್ದರೆ sp ರೇಖೀಯ. s-ಲಕ್ಷಣ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದಂತೆ ಬಂಧ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: sp³: 25% s, sp²: 33% s, sp: 50% s
Every single bond is σ; a double bond is 1σ + 1π; a triple bond is 1σ + 2π
π bonds need unhybridised p orbitals side by side

title.en: Carbon's shapes and ways to draw molecules

say.en: Carbon has four valence electrons and forms four bonds. With four single bonds it is sp3 and tetrahedral; with one double bond sp2 and flat; with a triple bond sp and linear.
Butane can be written in full, condensed, or as a bond-line zig-zag. In a bond-line formula every corner and line end is a carbon with enough hydrogens to make four bonds.

text.en: Each corner or end = one carbon

say.en: From the molecular formula, the degree of unsaturation counts rings plus pi bonds: C minus H over 2 plus N over 2 plus 1. Benzene, C6H6, has 4: three double bonds and one ring.

explanation.en: Four single bonds: sp³ (109.5°). One double bond: sp² (120°). A triple bond or two double bonds: sp (180°).

body.en: A complete structural formula shows every bond. A condensed formula groups atoms: CH₃CH₂OH. A bond-line formula shows only the zig-zag carbon skeleton: each corner or line end is a carbon carrying enough hydrogens to make four bonds, and heteroatoms are written out.
body.kn: ಪೂರ್ಣ ರಚನಾ ಸೂತ್ರ ಎಲ್ಲ ಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಸಂಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತ ಸೂತ್ರ ಪರಮಾಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಗುಂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಬಂಧ-ರೇಖಾ ಸೂತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೂಲೆಯೂ ಒಂದು ಕಾರ್ಬನ್.

problem.en: Count the σ and π bonds in HC≡C–CH=CH–CH₃.

steps.en: C–C σ bonds: 4 (one in each carbon–carbon link). C–H σ bonds: 1 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 6.
π bonds: 2 in C≡C and 1 in C=C.
